scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Primary mouse-model study in a biological disease context. Age wording stages AD-model phenotypes without explicitly interpreting a result as an aging process.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: App SAA knock-in genotype carrying Swedish, Arctic, and Austrian App mutations (heterozygous or homozygous)
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Amyloid pathology, microglial lipid/metabolite and transcriptomic alterations, brain metabolism, neurodegeneration markers, and behavioral phenotypes
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Characterization of outcomes in heterozygous and homozygous App SAA mice versus wild-type littermate controls
